title: centaurea jordaniana subsp. aemilii
intro: Centaurea jordaniana subsp. aemilii, commonly known as mountain cornflower, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea jordaniana subsp. aemilii include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects, and exhibit anti-inflammatory activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
